name: Hidden Crossbow Trap

source.title: Pathfinder Game Night: Dawn of the Frogs

disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) to deactivate the pressure plate on the floor

items.name: Spear
items.text:
Trigger Pressure is applied to the floor tile

---
Effect The trap shoots a crossbow bolt, making an attack against the creature or object on the floor tile.

text: A crossbow hidden inside the frog skull connects to a floor tile in the center of the chamber.
